entities.summary: Dhaka College, informally known as DC, is a public educational institution of Bangladesh located in the area of New Market, Dhaka. Established in 1841, it is one of the oldest educational institutions in the subcontinent. It offers honours and master's programs under Dhaka Central University and Higher Secondary Certificate under Dhaka Education Board.
